The '''Empire's Fury''' was an elite attack [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|True Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|navy]] which was built to secretly fight the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] in the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Every member had to strike independently on different places in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to damage the Republic effort swiftly. Every member received their own [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]]. The squadron was formed when the Empire found out about the formation of the Republic's own [[Coruscant Aegis]].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

*The [[Empire's Wrath]] as ''Tempest''<ref name="TOR" /> 
**Crew: [[Vette]], [[2V-R8 (Empire's Wrath)|2V-R8]], [[Malavai Quinn]], [[Pierce]], [[Broonmark]], [[Jaesa Willsaam]]<ref name="TOR" />

**Crew: [[Khem Val]] {{C|[[Darth Zash]]}}, [[2V-R8 (Darth Nox)|2V-R8]], [[Andronikos Revel]], [[Ashara Zavros]], [[Talos Drellik]], [[Xivhkalrainik]]<ref name="TOR" />
*The [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]] as ''Scree''<ref name="TOR" />
**Crew: [[Mako (slicer)|Mako]], [[2V-R8 (Hunter)|2V-R8]], [[Torian Cadera]], [[Gault Rennow]], [[Skadge]], [[Blizz]]<ref name="TOR" />
